title: No GPS, One Camera: Racing Drone AI
description: Anduril's AI Grand Prix is an autonomous drone race where all teams fly Neros hardware, so only software differs. Estonian-Czech team Remanguys, which uses one camera and no GPS or lidar, reached the finals in Columbus, Ohio.

beats.vo: No pilot, no GPS, no lidar. Just one camera and software, racing at speed.

beats.text: Same drone, only the software differs
beats.vo: In Anduril's AI Grand Prix, every team flies the same drone, so only software decides. One finalist says it estimates position and builds a three D map from a single camera. The finals are in Columbus, Ohio.
Follow for a daily dose of engineering.

caption:
No pilot. No GPS. One camera. 🏁
In Anduril's AI Grand Prix every team flies the same hardware; only the software differs. Tallinn-based Remānguys made the finals in Columbus, Ohio. Camera-accuracy figures are the team's own claims.
